name: LEXSA Coles online grocery vouchers
summary: Limited Coles grocery vouchers for LEXSA members who can't get to the Lismore campus, such as online students.
who: LEXSA members who can't get to the Lismore campus.
how: Register with the weekly form during term. Vouchers are emailed to you.
catches: Registrations fill up quickly once they open.
LEXSA membership costs $5 to join, then $1 a year to renew.

evidence.quote: registrations fill up quickly once registration opens
students can join for $5 then renew each year for $1
